name: ryanduguid-contracting
description: Ryan Duguid's Claude Code plugins for Australian contracting and subcontractor accounting work.

plugins.name: subcontractor-accounting-skills
plugins.description: Workflow skills for Australian subcontractor accounting: progress claims, retentions, work in progress and over/under-billing, contract cost tracking, plus the regimes a mining-services or earthmoving subcontractor lives with - fuel tax credits, the Coal LSL levy, payroll tax contractor provisions, plant costing, and contractor superannuation and TPAR. Each skill encodes the process and the tie-outs, and sends the agent to the primary source for rates, thresholds and statutory timeframes.
